_meanings:
.²1 A secondary direction or precept, a substitute or alternative to be
 used in times of necessity when the primary one ({#praTamakalpa#}) is

 not possible; as the direction to use {#goDUma#} or {#taRqula#} in the
 absence of {#yava#}; {#praBuH praTamakalpasya yo'nukalpena vartate#} <ls>Ms. 11. 30</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">3. 147</ls>.
.²2 A work connected with Kalpa (one of the six auxiliaries of the Vedas).
